_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. Entries with kind "drone" are stills from a drone video by a creator who gave permission (the video is in aerial.json); video_t is the second in the video, and source_url opens the video there. 'pairs' are before/after pairs shown under the satellite comparison. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.
